lines.en: The Dog and his Bone [ A dog is walking down the street, when he sees a bone in a trash can.
lines.zh: 狗和他的骨头：一只狗沿街走着，忽然看见垃圾桶里有根骨头。

lines.en: “A bone!
Yippee!
How lucky for me!
” he thinks.
He grabs the bone, and happily runs home.
lines.zh: 他叼起骨头，高高兴兴地往家跑。

lines.en: He runs past the train station and the school.
lines.zh: 他跑过火车站，又跑过学校。

lines.en: He runs through the park.
He runs onto a bridge.
On the bridge, the dog looks down into the deep, still water below.
lines.zh: 在桥上，狗低头看向桥下又深又静的水面。

lines.en: There, he sees another dog with a bone in its mouth.
lines.zh: 他看见水里还有一只狗，嘴里也叼着一根骨头。

lines.en: “Who is that dog?
” he wonders.
"What is he doing down there?"
The dog stares at the other dog.
The other dog stares back.
“Where did that dog get such a BIG bone?
lines.zh: “那只狗从哪儿弄来这么大一根骨头？

lines.en: ” the dog wonders.
"Why is his bone bigger than mine?"
The dog growls at the other dog.
The other dog growls too.
“I want that big bone!
” he thinks.
The greedy dog decides to steal the other dog's bone.
lines.zh: 贪心的狗决定去抢那只狗的骨头。

lines.en: He leaps off the bridge and into the water.
lines.zh: 他从桥上纵身跳进水里。

lines.en: Splash!
But as soon as he hits the water, the other dog disappears.
lines.zh: 可他刚一碰到水，那只狗就不见了。

lines.en: There was never any other dog.
lines.zh: 根本就没有什么别的狗。

lines.en: It was just his own reflection!
The water is very deep and the dog is surprised.
“Woof woof woof!
Help!
” he barks.
And when he barks, his bone drops from his mouth — and sinks to the bottom of the water.
lines.zh: 他一张嘴叫，骨头就从嘴里掉了出来——沉到了水底。

lines.en: The dog swims to shore.
He is wet and cold, and now he has no bone at all.
lines.zh: 他又湿又冷，而且现在连骨头也没有了。

lines.en: Moral: Be happy with what you have.
If you're greedy, you might lose everything.
lines.zh: 太贪心的话，可能连原本有的也会失去。
